notes: Fast connectivity check.

name: Battery level
notes: 0=full,1=medium,2=low,3=empty,4=exhausted,5=charging.

name: Event notification (TCP 3333)
notes: Status codes: 1 record start,2 record stop,8 sensor count,9 card insert,10 card remove,11/12 protect on/off,13/14 GPS on/off,16 photo download,21/22 timelapse. Some mappings inferred.

name: Save settings
notes: Persist after 3003/3004/3032 etc.

name: Hardware capability
notes: Observed K5 handler returns 0x13=19. Older NT9666x docs show 3; treat as a capability bitmask/code, not a fixed version.

name: SD card state
notes: 0=removed,1=inserted/normal,2=locked/error.

name: Delete one file

name: Delete all files
params: none (stock app); path parameter not established
notes: Destructive. Not used by stock K5 UI (it deletes selected files one-by-one with 4003). Exact path/filter parameter not established.

name: Upload file

notes: Not used by the stock K5 UI. The RTOS handler names are XML_UploadFile / XML_UploadAudio; exact HTTP framing, mime type and segment count are not established. Test on a spare device only.
